Method of Attack: Distributed using Word documents with malicious macros that download and install the ransomware
Macros trick user into enabling content to execute obfuscated PowerShell commands
PowerShell command downloads and executes winx64.exe ransomware executable
Encrypts victim data appending extension based on MachineGuid
Sends statistics and information about infected victims to Command & Control servers using multiple UDP IP ranges
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Microsoft Word and PowerShell
Attack Vector: Malicious Word document email attachments with macros
